Wabil starts from point A and drives 2 km towards east. He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final left turn and drives 1 km and stops at point B. Dilo starts from point P, which is 16 km east of Point A, and drives 6 km towards west. He then takes a left turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn and drives 3 km and stops at Point Q. What is the shortest distance between Point Q and Point B?(Note: All turns are 90 degree turns only.)

A statement is given followed by two conclusions. Indian cuisine is quite popular in New York.II. Priyanka Chopra is currently living in New York after marriage with Nick Jonas.
options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
